$comment: Craftability rules. A card is craftable (and therefore has dust value) only when its set is in 'craftable_sets', its rarity is in 'craftable_rarities' and its type is in 'craftable_types', and it is not listed in 'uncraftable_card_ids'. A set that appears in neither list has UNKNOWN craftability: the core treats it as not craftable for dust purposes and reports it, rather than guessing.
source: python-hearthstone v9.22.0 enums.CardSet.craftable / Rarity.craftable / CardType.craftable; hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Crafting (Core set and free cards are uncraftable). 'BE' (Reign of the Black Empire) added by hand because python-hearthstone had not listed it yet — validated in CI as a warning, not an error.
$comment_hand_added: STORMWIND (United in Stormwind) and REVENDRETH (Murder at Castle Nathria) are ordinary expansions missing from python-hearthstone's CardSet.craftable list (an upstream omission, 9.22.0); EXPERT1 is the Classic set, still 245 collectible cards in HearthstoneJSON and craftable in Wild (hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Crafting: only FREE-rarity Legacy cards cannot be crafted); YEAR_OF_THE_DRAGON holds the Galakrond's Awakening adventure cards, craftable per hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Galakrond's_Awakening ('both regular and golden versions can be crafted and disenchanted for the usual amounts'). HERO_SKINS (collectible hero portraits) and CORE_HIDDEN (Core cards of past years, kept as entities) are never craftable. Found by QA 2026-10-15 against the live catalog (build 255026).
$comment_regular_only: Sets whose REGULAR copies are uncraftable while the golden ones can be crafted (hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Uncraftable: 'All regular Demon Hunter Initiate cards').
$comment_how_to_earn: HearthstoneJSON's howToEarn / howToEarnGolden (enUS) is set on copies obtained outside packs. The game marks such reward copies 'Uncraftable: this card cannot be disenchanted or crafted' (login events, free launch legendaries 'Earnable after opening a ... card pack', Reward Track / Tavern Pass goldens, achievements, BlizzCon, honor rewards). The texts matching 'how_to_earn_craftable_patterns' are NOT rewards: they describe crafting itself or the old adventure unlocks, which have been craftable since 2020. Verified in game on 2026-10-15 (Marin the Fox regular, golden SN1P-SN4P: 'cannot be disenchanted or crafted'). Any other howToEarn text = uncraftable copy of that premium kind.
$comment_overrides: Explicit per-card overrides win over everything above: dbf ids (as strings or numbers) whose regular / golden copies are blocked in the game, or the opposite. Keep the shipped lists for cards whose game status disagrees with the data; 'dustplanner collection block <card> [--golden]' writes the same keys into <home>/data/non-craftable.json, which is MERGED with this file (a partial file is enough).
